repair_levers.semantic_rationale: A public input-domain repair that directly makes the nonnegative postcondition provable.
A weaker public input-domain edit that is insufficient alone but can support a body repair.
An implementation edit that shifts the result and is insufficient for unrestricted integer inputs.

groups.semantic_rationale: Both assigned levers edit the declared input domain of the same public method.
The assigned lever changes the executable assignment in the method body.

design_rationale: The two contract edits and the body edit are independently meaningful Dafny repairs. The grouping follows source construct ownership, not verifier outcomes.
